original_metadata.title: Smooth geometric orbital linearization of completely integrable vector fields with independent jets and the required zero-eigenvalue integral rank
original_metadata.author: Nguyen Tien Zung
original_metadata.source_title: Orbital Linearization of Smooth Completely Integrable Vector Fields
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The elliptic part removes a flat nonlinear error by proving periodicity through injective first-integral maps on shrinking transverse balls and propagating that property across singular levels. A blow-up then makes the period correction smooth and flat, allowing circle-action linearization and a further invariant multiplier normalization. This new smooth mechanism exceeds applying a formal normal-form theorem or the hyperbolic Sternberg-Chen theorem.

proof_review.note: Complete Theorem1.1 proof and Sections2-3 support read: resonance/semisimplicity, Borel realization of prior formal geometric linearization, reduction by independent zero-eigenvalue integrals, strong hyperbolic Sternberg-Chen case, and the new elliptic periodic-orbit proof with adapted integrals, small transverse-ball injectivity, flat return map and engulfing argument. The blow-up converts the period correction into a smooth flat correction; compact circle-action linearization and a second normalization make the multiplier a first integral. Ziglin adapted-integral lemma, formal geometric linearization, de Rham division, Borel realization and compact-action linearization are established cited background. Routine uniform versions for parameter families and the explicit blow-up flatness lemma are stated rather than separately expanded. Local source typos: Section2.4 prints a zero wedge while using the nonzero wedge of hypothesisiii as coordinates; several neighboring Fi counts read Fn where the stated system has n-1 integrals. The theorem statement supplies the unambiguous rank assumptions; original proof is unchanged. No redundancy of conditioniii or planar refinement counted.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Smooth X near0 in R^n with X(0)=0, n-1 smooth first integrals independent almost everywhere and formally independent infinity jets, and nonzero semisimple part of the linearization. If zero is an eigenvalue with multiplicity k>=1, dF1(0) wedge ... wedge dFk(0) must be nonzero after the stated ordering. There are local smooth coordinates with X=F X^(1), X^(1) semisimple linear, F(0)=1 and X^(1)(F)=0. The rank assumptioniii is retained; no general claim that it is redundant.
original_metadata.editorial_warning: Section2.4 has a local zero-wedge sign typo, while hypothesisiii and the immediately following coordinate construction require a nonzero wedge; local Fn counts refer to the n-1 first integrals. These author slips are disclosed without modifying the reproduced source.
